nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel Lotion Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.texte: Although i sweat i havent had the need to coean my eyes due to getting into my eyes it blends really well and is a much cheaper alternative to supergoop the next best i could find.
I really like this sunscreen, it is hydrating without being too heavy and I haven't had any issues with it burning my eyes.

Not sure why there are so many negative reviews on this…. I have dry very sensitive skin and my skin drinks this up. It goes on smooth, no white cast, doesn't irritate my skin (my skin is very sensitive) and gives great coverage. I take this with me in my beach bag and can be sitting in the sun and I don't burn at all. Also I wear contacts and this does not irritate my eyes - even on beach vacations where I am constantly sweating still no irritation.

I really liked this sunscreen at first- It left my skin looking great and was non-irritating. But, if you're going to be sweating a lot I would NOT recommend. I was in Disney, and because of the sweating, it got in my eyes and BURNED!!

Love this sunscreen because it blends in clear to your face and leaves a dewy finish that makes you glow. Also like the spf level on it. Only con is that a couole tikes throguout the day it burns my eyes and makes my eyes water which is very painful.

I like it,smells good and feels good on your skin. Doesn't leave a greasy residue. The bad thing is that burns your eyes so bad,so I just use it far from my eyes and I use a mineral one around my eyes.

I actually loved the lightweight feel of this sunscreen! It smelled great and felt so fresh on my skin but I used it twice and made my cheeks and eyelids burn both times! Definitely not a sunscreen for my sensitive skin.

The formula it light, goes on clear. Unfortunately it is heavily fragranced, but I don't hate the smell so it's tolerable for me. The horrible thing about this is that it my eyes STING SO BAD when I wear it. I'm keeping it for my décolleté, so at least it wasn't a total waste!

I've tried about everything possible to not get this product to, but no matter what I do it pills. The formula is great, super watery and lightweight, but its also just makes my makeup sit poorly and then pill. I do LOVE this on the body however. It gives you a gorgeous, hydrated glow.
this is my fav sunscreen of all time!! no whitecast, makes your skin look glowy, dermatologist recommended, and doesnt break me out! ride or die product fs
this is my fav sunscreen of all time!! no whitecast, makes your skin look glowy, dermatologist recommended, and doesnt break me out! ride or die product fs
I really wanted to love this sunscreen, it feels great on the skin but it sting my eyes really bad all day my eyes were teary to the point where I had to completely wash it off.

Used this all last Summer daily on my face & neck, nvr got a sunburn so works wonderfully in that area. As for leaving my skin feeling moisturized not so much. I can apply 2 layers an still have some dry spots. Overall tho it's a good product.
I stock up on this during the summer, it smells great and the texture is similar to a higher end brand ive bought in the past. But the price of this is such a steal in comparison.
This burned my eyes so bad even when i applied it and avoided the eye area it still was painful. Its also pretty greasy and too fragrant for me personally. Only postive thing is no white cast.

avis.titre: My only complaint is the heavy scent
avis.texte: I use this as a daily AM moisturizer and it does a good job, however the scent is overpowering. I'm a guy and it smells like I'm wearing a woman's perfume. I wish they would make an unscented version.

I love that its spf 50, its hydrating on my dry skin, and it does not leave a white cast. However, it is very thick and putting on too much will leave your skin greasy. It also has a super heavy scent. If you have ultra sensitive skin or oily skin, skip this one. My fear with this one is because it is so thick and a little goes a long way, we arent putting on enough for it to be effective. As well in the summer this does make my face super greasy. It also is super messy in the packaging because of how greasy it is. There are definitely better sunscreens out there.

I do not recommend this to anyone, it's smells good but that's about it. It stings and burns the eyes so bad if you put it anywhere in your face, even if it's not close to the eye area. It also peels alot. Overall I do not recommend

I found this product to be exactly what I want/need - a good body lotion with SPF. It absorbs quickly and definitely left my skin feeling moisturized without the tackiness I sometimes encounter using just sunscreen. I didn't notice any scent until I was using a larger amount to cover my legs, and even then it wasn't strong and faded quickly. I was a bit confused why the ingedients listed online had oxybenzone included when it also says 'oxybenzone free', but it wasn't listen on my bottle so I'm assuming it's from an old formula (if anyone else is wondering about that). I haven't encountered burning eyes, but I also haven't and wouldn't use this product on my face due to texture and personal preference. I removed one star because it's marketed for face and body, when I believe it should only be used for body.
Do you like the feeling of thousands of little knives stabbing your eyeballs? If so, this product is for you!

avis.titre: I enjoy this for my body
avis.texte: DO NOT BUY THIS FOR YOUR FACE!!! This stings the eyes and its very greasy/oily/hydrating. This should be marketed as a body sunscreen and come in a bigger size. I acually like the scent, it smells clean and the scent goes away quickly. I would prefer if this came unscented because I dont like skincare with a scent. I have dry skin and this helps me rehydrate when I put more on. Im dark skinned and it dosent have a cast whatsoever. Ive bought this numerous times, and its perfect to get that glow.

avis.titre: Can't deal with stinging eyes any longer :(
avis.texte: I love how hydrating this product is and how it pairs nicely with all of my makeup. However, even when I apply it and then set my whole face with powder, it gets into my eyes and stings no matter what! It's just too irritating to continue using. I read online somewhere that chemical SPF ingredients like in this product are more likely to be irritating, so I will be switching to an alternative! It also applies with a pretty greasy finish, so if you don't get irritation from chemical SPF but are looking for a matte-finish sunscreen then this won't be for you.

avis.titre: good for the body, not ideal for the face
avis.texte: i love the texture of this. it's lightweight and absorbs well, doesn't have a strong scent (personally, i can't discern a scent at all), and it doesn't pill up or react poorly with other skincare or makeup i've used with it. unfortunately, even when i try to avoid my eyes, throughout the day it migrates and eventually burns them anyways. i'm not in the business of being careful about where i want my SPF, so i'm going to use this up on my body and find another one for my face that i'll be able to use all over without stinging

Over the last year I've been trying out a bunch of sunscreens at different price points, and this one outdoes them all! It's so smooth and soft and hydrating! Even though there's a bit of a fragrance, it's not super overpowering! At long as you're careful about not rubbing it in too hard, there's no pilling and it absorbs quickly.

I love the transparency of this. It's lightweight and clear. However, it runs despite claiming to be sweat resistant. It always seems to find its way into my eyes, and Im constantly wiping it off, which defeats the purpose of why Im wearing it.

This is a great hydrating sunscreen if you have normal to dry skin. I'd stay away if you're combo or oily. I can't wear my normal moisturizer when I wear this because it makes me too oily. It's great for someone who wants to minimize the amount of products they have to use in the morning. It is heavily scented. It reminds me of fruity pebbles cereal. It does cause burning/ stinging if it gets into your eyes, but I have experienced that with other sunscreens as well. My contacts will also become blurry if I accidentally rub my eye. This has pros and cons, so it depends on skin type and what you're looking for. Great for price point.
I LOVE THIS as a body sunscreen. No weird smells, no acne on my back and shoulders after use, actually protects, AND doesn't leave stains on my clothes/swimsuits. This really is a favorite of mine!

This was the first sunscreen I ever got after I learned the importance of spf, and its amazing. I like to try new sunscreens and i've learned that I usually prefer mineral sunscreens but I always keep a tube of this around in case my skin doesnt react well to whatever else i'm experimenting with or if it leaves a white cast. I know I can always rely on this one. Its so hydrating and makes my skin feel like silk. Usually not a fan of the dewy finishes and prefer matte sunscreens but I love how this one looks. Its the perfect dew and doesnt look oily. There's definitely a little bit of fragrance in there which I usually try to avoid but its very light and doesnt irritate my skin at all. Rubs in very easily and leaves you feeling very hydrated all day long.

avis.titre: Do not recommend over skin Care. It BURNS
avis.texte: Tried it first all over my face after my skin care morning routine, but it started to burn my face and eyes. Next day tried it just on my face and somehow my eyes were burning again. Horrible product it become flacky and clumsy is you rub you face with anything.

So torn. I love that this has no white cast and it makes my skin look dewy and not greasy even if i apply a good amount.. but it's weirdly not hydrating. Actually, my skin feels a little tight and dry although it looks dewy. And the fragrance doesnt bother me- but it reminds me of deodorant lol.
This sunscreen burned the skin around my eyes and it always somehow got in my eyes, it does blend well into skin and is clean. I don't think it caused me acne but it really burns the eyes.

I have used this product before (without thorough research) but switched to a different one. Now wanting to go back and it says formulated without oxybenzone when it literally shows that it's one of the main ingredients! Glad I did my research this time.
Scent did not bother me, lotion comes out blue but blends out just fine. Goes on greasy and stays that way. Pills under makeup and rubs off.
Every time I try something different I always go back to this sunscreen. Not only is it SPF 50 but it goes on as a dewy finish for those no makeup days but it also looks beautiful under makeup.

It feels like a light gel, similar to the water gel moisturizer, which I also love. This doesn't pill on the front of my face, although I have picked off the occasional blue piece off of the side of my face. However, I could care less because it feels good, smells good, leaves no white cast, and gives me a bit of dewiness.

To preface my review, I use retinol in my night regime. Sunscreen is a must for me because of that, and I prefer 45 and up. I saw online that this would be a great sunscreen for dark skin consumers and while that is the truth, the smell was quite perfume-ish. If you have sensitive, acne-prone skin (face or body), you know thats a huge no! For the sake of testing for a white cast, I applied anyways and immediately felt a burn! Not an itch, or tingle but a burn. I am usually one who prefers testing before reading too far into personal reviews because I like to develop my own personal experience with a product, and I bit a bullet with this one. I had my topical hydrocortisone so I applied that after washing this off and returned it.
Good for sun protection but if you put too much it wall get in your eyes and burn like crazy. Smell isnt great but its normal sunscreen smell. Bit of a white cast. Not using it anymore.

This is the perfect chest & arm sunscreen! Fully dries within a minute or so, starts blue and quickly goes CLEAR. Doesn't leave me feeling sticky at all and no strong fragrance once applied! I can't recommend this enough to the "I hate sunscreen" people.
I would love it if it doesn't burn my eyes and fragrance free. The fragrance was too overwhelming I couldn't handle so I use this on my body instead.

Great product. It is very lightweight and not greasy. It dries down pretty fast and leaves my skin feeling smooth. Its also great under makeup. The only flaw I see is that it is scented which doesnt bother me, but may bother some people. Another con would be that if you sweat it will get in your eyes and burn. The burning lasts a long time when this happens.
I honestly didn't hate this sunscreen. About a quarter of a finger is enough for a full face and it doesn't leave a white cast.
this is my favorite sunscreen because it doesn't leave me looking ashy and crusty, it makes your skin look glows and looks rlly good underneath makeup too! i would def buy again!
Works pretty well! I give it four stars since it does peel with different products so I mainly used it for my arms and legs. There is a scent but for me, it's not super strong or irritating.
I really liked fgis sunscreen and was so easy to rub in but it stung my eyes so bad

Bogo 40% off. It arrived opened in the bag, leaked all over. No seal. It smells so strong that I can't imagine using it. Not a good review, but Im done shopping at Ulta. They dont care about their products or customers.
The scent is way too strong. I didnt bother to even put it on my face.

I tried this product since an Ulta employee recommended it when I asked for SPF for dry skin. I have acne prone + dry skin (17 yrs old). I have used better products, but wanted to save money so I tried a cheaper alternative. But I did some research and the ingredients aren't very good. Plus the smell lasts all day, pills w/ certain products, and makes my face feel greasy.
Everything about this is great, but the deal breaker is this made my eyes burn for hours I will never recover

I am a brown guy. So I am always looking for sunscreen that does not leave a white cast. This one is really good at it and my skin absorbs it really fast. However, I can feel a chemical smell all day on my face. It makes me tear up and just feel uncomfortable overall. I like other sunscreens out there, but they are about $40 a pop. I will keep searching for my favorite and most affordable daily sunscreen.

avis.titre: Keeps skin moisturized and also provides SPF protection.
avis.texte: Great for protecting skin against the sun and keeping my skin hydrated. Helps prevent sunburn while being out in the sun. Perfect for the summer months.
Pretty strong fragrance and has a weird chunky texture as if oil is separating in it. But it does absorb well without a whitecast and would be great for those with dry skin

This sunscreen is fantastic!!!! It absorbs quickly and leaves no white cast at all. It doesn't transfer to to clothing or hair. It has a radiant finish which looks great if you like the luminous look.

I ran out of sunscreen and decided to give this one a try while waiting for my usual to ship in. The first time I applied it, my eyes stung and it also irritated my cheeks (redness, kind of rash looking and feeling) so I rinsed it off immediately. Pro there is that it is easy to remove. Ive been applying less product and that definitely lessens the irritation but most likely makes it less effective in blocking the sun. ALSO. it pills so badly. i cant put any skin product on no concealer not even skin tint. I havent tried reapplying the sunscreen even but im scared that that will pill as well. overall i would not buy this product again.

I purchased this to take with me on a hiking trip and took the bottle with me. It was moderately warm (70s) but the sunscreen had separated into a cottage cheese consistency. I tried shaking it but it never reconstituted. I was sunburned after it separated. Not ideal for anything other than your counter.

avis.titre: NOTHING has ever burned my eyes
avis.texte: Until this! Awful, awful. I don't have sensitive skin or eyes and never had this happen. No idea what's in this. STAY AWAY

I purchased this thinking a gel sunscreen would be good in the summer but this makes me look and feel really greasy. It burns the mess out of your eyes. I've been wearing sunscreen for years so I know never to put it near my eyes but somehow this still got into my eyes at some point during the day. Sunscreen should be effortless. I shouldn't have to remember to never touch my face while wearing or only wear around the house because of the greasy mess it creates on my face if I wear it with makeup.
10\10 will always repurchase, i love this spf so much. it moisturized my skin, never left me feeling greasy.
I am in absolute love with the water jelly serum like consistency. This gel is so hydrating and leaves me dewy.

I've been using this for years, it's the only unscreen that I will wear on my face. It goes on clear and feels very light weight. Most sunscreens are thick and make my face feel dry but this one is hydrating. It does make my face more oily than usual but a little setting powder does the trick. I just avoid around my eyes and mouth when applying so that it doesn't get into either when it settles through the day.
I love that it's not too greasy like the normal ones it's just leaves your skin pretty glowy and it feels really fresh

This is now my go to sunscreen!! Amazing under makeup, moisturizing, no white cast whatsoever, and is affordable for a really good sunscreen like this. It can be a little harsh on sensitive skin but it's not for me. Totally recommend this product!

avis.titre: Strong scent I can smell all day
avis.texte: This works well with my dry skin, but I could only recommend it with this caveat: It stinks to high heaven, and it stays. all. day. I can smell it on my face just as strongly six hours after putting it on. Even with makeup on over it, and perfume.
This sunscreen stings my eyes and feels greasy on the skin. Doesn't layer well for reapplication.
I love Neutrogena products ,but when i use hydro boost i feel bad because my expectations failed. It really burns my eyes.

This sunscreen spreads easily and I like the fresh smell of it. It comes out in this bluish color that unfortunately dulls the warmth of my skin's complexion. It's not incredibly noticeable, but still noteworthy. On the skin, it leaves a filmy sort of texture that's moisturizing. I don't see myself repurchasing because this product often left residue on my furniture, especially within the black interior of my car. It's become a hassle having to clean my car after every drive.
I was looking for a face sunscreen that was clear, one that didn't run and leave white streaks if I perspired. Very happy so far

I've never been able to use liquid sunscreen due to my sensory disorder, but for whatever reason, this sunscreen is the one that I can wear AND love! It has a really unique smell that doesn't smell like usual sunscreen either, which I personally love. This is hydrating for those with dry skin and my sensitive skin has not reacted one bit. I would definitely recommend for someone looking for a good hydrating, non-sticky, easy to blend sunscreen :)

avis.titre: High SPF without the white cast and sticky feeling
avis.texte: This is the only sunscreen I will use. It moisturizes your skin, has a high SPF, and doesn't leave you feeling sticky. The gel formula absorbs in nicely and gives your skin a hydrated look.
This goes on like a great hydrating moisturizer. Wouldn't even know it's sunscreen by the feel. I wear it every day on my face, ears, neck, and chest with no sticky feeling or residue.

this would be great if it didnt sting my eyes. i love the texture and the fragrance doesnt bother me but ive noticed whenever i use this sunscreen it makes my eyes sting like crazy. if you have this and didnt like it for your face, you can use it as a body sunscreen!
It doesn't leave a white cast but it's too oily for my taste.

avis.titre: Good for price. Not great for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: Blends in well but stays greasy. Not for anyone with oily skin (although my dry skin also wasn't enjoying it). Fragrance stung my eyes.
This burned my eyes so bad and I didn't even put it close to my eyes on my face. Never again!

i've had this for a long while and it doesn't feel sticky or greasy on the skin, it doesn't leave a white cast. However, there is a fragrance which doesn't bother me in particular but it may for those with sensitive skin, and if you touch your face a lot the sunscreen will pill.
I have dry sensitive skin and this sunscreen goes on great - it's light weight and doesn't have a scent that I notice.

I was presently surprised with the texture of it, and how it felt when I patch tested on my hand. I have acne prone, sensitive skin I really tried to like it but it kept burning when I put it on. Really quite a shame.

I have NEVER had a sunscreen that did this to me- I had to return it after 3 uses because of how badly it burned my eyes. Idk if it's the perfume or what but my eyes were in literal tears. Took off and felt better almost immediately.

I was excited to try this product but after one application it literally left me blind for 2 hours. I had to wash it out of my eyes poison control style and still had to wait for the severe burning to stop. I wouldn't be surprised if a this product is linked to severe eye damage in the future. You're better off risking a severe sunburn
Gave me horrible breakouts. I used it with my staple holy grail skin care products. Gave a few tries but everytime it's the same.
First time using this, not near as greasy as most sunblock. It did the job and will definitely buy it again
I love the Hydro Boost products and have been using the gel moisturizer for a few months. With summer coming I thought I'd try this. Works well as a sunscreen but leaves my face feeling greasy

I wanted to love this so much. It looks beautiful on my skin and doesn't feel sticky or heavy. BUT if you get it even near your eye it burns for the rest of the day. It felt like no matter how much I tried to rinse it out, it never got better

I have never used a sunscreen which irritates my eye, but this one does. It's really bad when that happens. I am never going to repurchase this product. If you sweat then it's going to be worse, gets all sticky and peals off which looks bad.
Goes on easy, no white cast, and while there is a fragrance, it is pretty mild and without the typical hardh sunscreen scent.

I wanted to love this since I'm a big fan of the hydro boost moisturizer but not even 5 minutes after applying it was completely pilling off of my face and left film. The fragrance was also overpowering and even though I kept it away from my eye area, it still burned my eyes from the fragrance. Will be returning
the texture of this product is different than traditional lotions. it goes on well and protects great. my only complaint is I can smell my face all day after using it.
It goes on well but if accidentally you get it in the eye the stinging does not go away for hours. It is also a little heavy on artificial fragrance.

avis.titre: Never would buy this product again
avis.texte: I bought this though it would be great for my skin, but it's peeling off my skin and so annoying I have to get a towel to clean it .
Doesn't break my skin out or leave a white cast (I am very pale though) I will say if you don't at least rinse your nighttime skincare off the next morning Before using this then it will ball up
It leaves a film and skin feels tight after applying amply. Also pills somewhat. I do like the smell but that's about it. Won't be buying again.

I like the smooth texture, glides on and is hydrating. As my skin ages, I tend to stay away from anything too drying. I do not love the scent, it is very fragrant!! AND it burns my eyes so bad!! It's really , really uncomfortable when that happens. Avoid the eye area completely when using this product. Will finish using product but will NOT repurchase until the formula improves.

avis.titre: Takes forever to soak in and pills with other products
avis.texte: I always apply two finger lengths of sunscreen in two separate layers and this sunscreen just can't do it. You either have to put it under your moisturizer and wait an hour before applying anything else, or put it over moisturizer and wait an hour before you can put on makeup. This stuff has ruined good makeup days multiple times for me and is so frustrating! It pills up so bad and gets stuck in your hair! If you want to wear it on its own then it is hydrating and glowy but ONLY on its own.
Don't buy , burns on skin and the color of the lotion is blue ?

No, people! Skip this product and get something else instead. I have never had a sunscreen burn my skin as badly as this one! This sunscreen does not settle into the skin, it just sits on top and slides around when you apply makeup on top. Do not get this sunscreen if you are planning to be active and sweat, because trust me sister, it will burn your eyes!

I think I have a sensitivity/allergy to something in this sunscreen—I'm not sure which ingredient(s) are causing the reaction—but the experience has only occurred with sunscreens, and causes my skin to tingle and burn, and my eyes to water and burn if in close proximity. I liked the texture and feel of this sunscreen, but it definitely has whatever sunscreen ingredients I'm sensitive to, because after 5-10 minutes of wear I would start to react. Had to return.

I normally use Biore UV Aqua rich watery essence 50+++ but ran out and my shipment from Japan was late lol. I was suggested this product as a dupe for the Biore..it is not. It's not bad tho..leaves just a slight white cast, not sticky. Better for body than face IMO. Be careful around the eyes, it will burn.

avis.titre: This needs to be addressed to Neuteogena
avis.texte: If someone can point this out to Neutrogena to do better, please do. If they claim to not use Oxybenzone, then why does their formula have 4.5% of it? This is not the only ingredient that pollutes oceans. This is the reason why I moved on to other companies that do care about the environment and I wish Neutrogena did the same thing because I grew up using their products until now. Sorry not sorry, Neutrogena.
says it's formulated without oxybenzone and yet that's listed as one of the main ingredients????

avis.titre: Eye irritation is not worth it
avis.texte: I used to use the SPF 30 with no problem, but for whatever reason the 50 runs into your eyes and burns badly whether you sweat or not. Would not purchase again and will be returning the extra one I bought.

avis.titre: Not water resistant even to sweat… SUPER IRRITATING
avis.texte: Was waiting to use up my other neutrogena sunscreen, but I got this when it was on sale. It's not what I usually use. Oh my god this stuff is TERRIBLE! Twice now, I've put it on my face to go outside and the second I start to sweat, the sunscreen sins into my eyes. It's SUPER eye irritating, I'm talking 24 hours ever after flushing with water, and made my eyes super sensitive to the sun. DO NOT BUY THIS. I'm just upset I'm outside my window to return it.

Overall it's awful, the amount of times that I've applied this, and it's made its way into my eyes, causing them to burn and tear up is ridiculous. The only pro is doesn't leave a white cast, but what it does leave is an oily sheen, it looks like I applied a bottle of oil on my face especially if I'm using the correct amount. Definitely do not recommend.

I love everything about this sunscreen except the fact that it pills off your skin. If I just wear it alone and don't put make up over it, it's fine but when I put makeup on, it pills off horribly and I end up basically wiping the sunscreen off my face with my makeup, which sucks because I like the consistency, feel, and smell of this sunscreen.

I like this sunscreen okay. It was my first time using a sunscreen like this. It didn't leave a white cast. It has a light scent that I like. It was super easy to blend in like a lotion. The only reason I haven't repurchased it yet is that sometimes it messes with my eyes. I don't put it around my eye area, but my eyes tear up a lot sometimes. I don't if it's the scent or what. Other than that, I would recommend.

i love how lightweight this spf is ans the texture is great. however, every time i use this product, it pills off my face in giant chunks which is a bit concerning. also makes it very difficult to layer under foundation when it looks like your skin is peeling off. hoping neutrogena resolves this issue soon because i love the feel of this.

avis.titre: Protects my acne scarred skin! Pairs great with retinol
avis.texte: This product replaced my lotion. I never bought the water-cream products because it seems so expensive for a tiny amount. Even though I have combination skin, it helps so much especially since the retinol I'm on for my hyperpigmentation makes my skin very dry without this lotion. It can be a bit "greasy" but to me I see it as super fast absorbing and leaves a beautiful glowy/glass look to my skin. Goes great with my Ordinary and CeraVe skincare, and has never balled up on my skin even with foundation/concealer/powder. LOVE it- and as a brown skinned girl the blue cast fades within a minute. I've bought this twice now and getting a third.
smelled great, but when put on was super greasy and occasionally pulled under makeup. i don't recommend
I had bought this to wear while working out but the minute I start sweating it gets in my eyes and stings so badly. Also, it's pretty heavily scented and the scent doesn't fade quickly.
This is my fave. Blends in quick and you don't get burnt! Not greasy!!!! Price is high but worth it!!!!!

avis.titre: Its good, if you don't sweat.
avis.texte: I used this product a LOT. I wear SPF every day and I wanted something better for my face cause C0vid has made me break out a lot due to masks. Well this SPF can and WILL leak into your eyes and it stings so so bad. If you sweat any amount and ANY gets into your eyes, its over. You'll be a teary mess all day.
This product burn my eyes and smelt too chemical. I would not recommend this product

it's okay. it's sheer but it's like super oily when it comes out the bottle. and it looks good like a in between dewy not too Dewy so that's good. but it smells very strong like you can taste it and it really stings your eyes. but yeah there's no white caste and it looks nice on skin. it's just uncomfortable because it smells and stings my eyes

One of the employees recommended this to me, so I bought it. I hate it. I can barely keep my eyes open, I keep tearing up, my eyes burn. I've watched my face multiple times now and it still burns. I want my money back.

I have been using this for about a year or so. It has been my everyday go to sunscreen. I ordered two bottles a month ago and both have this oil that separates from the lotion. It's awfully greasy! It's nothing like before, even the color is more blue and artificial looking. My face is left so shiny ! Will have to find another everyday sunscreen for my sensitive skin.

I bought this product way back and I patch tested it on my hand. I have tannish skin and there was no white cast on my skin. It had a cooling and hydrating feel! The fragrance is extremely strong (Banana Boat Scent) and it was stinging my eyes once I applied near my eyes. I would not recommend this product. Invest in Paula's Choice or Korean Sunscreen.
i like how it doesnt really have a white cast but i hate how it feels super greasy on my skin and it's made me break out on my chin:(
I hate it. I threw it away. Burned my eyes and the surrounding skin sooo bad

I don't have oily skin but this is so greasy and oily on me! I have combination skin and I use this sunscreen together with Neutrogena's Hydro boost water cream moisturizer. My face gets so shiny after an hour application. Today, I set my face with setting powder so hopefully my forehead won't look shiny and gross throughout the day! The good thing about it is it glides easily on face but it also has a weird smell that I don't like.
I avoid my eyes and mouth when applying, but it still makes my eyes burn and I get it in my mouth some how. Even after washing my hands after use. It also beads up on my skin. Garbage time using it
